mainEntity.name: How much does an Audi A6 30 TFSI - 55 TFSI engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full rebuilt Audi A6 30 TFSI - 55 TFSI engine typically costs between £3,200 and £5,500 for supply only, with reconditioned units starting from £2,000.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of water pump failure in an Audi A6 30 TFSI - 55 TFSI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include coolant leaks under the vehicle or a distinct sweet smell from the engine bay. You may also experience an illuminated engine management light or the engine running hotter than normal.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in an older Audi A6 30 TFSI - 55 TFSI (C7 generation)?

acceptedAnswer.text: For C7 models valued between £8,000 and £18,000, a full rebuild is highly financially viable. A reconditioned or rebuilt unit restores reliability and comes with a 12-month warranty.

mainEntity.name: How long does an Audi A6 30 TFSI - 55 TFSI engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard supply and fit procedure for the 2.0L or 3.0L TFSI engine typically takes 2 to 3 working days at a specialist workshop.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the CYRB and DEJA engines in the Audi A6 30 TFSI - 55 TFSI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both are 2.0-litre turbocharged petrol engines, but the DEJA is the updated version introduced in the 2018 C8 facelift. The DEJA features a slightly lower output (190hp vs 252hp) due to updated emissions controls and the integration of a 12V/48V mild-hybrid system, improving overall efficiency.
